keeper_secrets.prose: Ke Wujiu's body is interred in a sealed basement lair behind boarded walls; his mind still lives and haunts the house.
Ke preserved his identity with Mythos magic and animates his own corpse; stats/presentation under monsters.json 'Ke Wujiu' (STR 90 CON 115 POW 90, Dominate, Flesh Ward, claws).
Ke's ritual dagger bypasses Flesh Ward and spells; a successful hit turns him to ashes and dust (the-haunting.json corbitt_own_dagger).
The floating knife costs Ke 1 Magic Point per combat round and attacks once per round; opposed STR vs POW to keep hold.
Ke first misleads and scares (upstairs poltergeist as false center); if investigators persist toward the basement secret, he switches to murder.
Pastor Michael Thomas of the Chapel of Contemplation executed Ke's will; the 1912 raid and Thomas's 1917 escape are cult residue, not required for the climax.

endings.summary: Ke is reduced to ash; the house can be rented again.
The investigators flee Binjiang and leave the house to Huo.
